name: grokbot-vehicle-fleet
description: Vehicle and energy-site (Powerwall/solar) status + confirm-gated vehicle commands via the official Fleet API, with your own developer app, tokens and command proxy. One vehicle-fleet MCP server (read-only unless TESLA_FLEET_READ_ONLY is explicitly off; cached-first reads; never auto-wakes) + skills.

TESLA_CLIENT_ID.title: Client ID
TESLA_CLIENT_ID.description: Required. YOUR developer app's client ID (developer portal). Each installer uses their own app; credentials are never shared.

TESLA_FLEET_CLIENT_ID.title: Client ID (alias)
TESLA_FLEET_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional alias for TESLA_CLIENT_ID, for env loaders that already export this name. Used only when TESLA_CLIENT_ID is unset.

TESLA_REFRESH_TOKEN.title: Refresh token (seed)
TESLA_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Seed refresh token from YOUR OAuth consent (or run scripts/auth-helper.mjs instead). Used only until the plugin stores its rotated token. Never commit.

TESLA_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Client secret
TESLA_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. Used only by the operator-run scripts/auth-helper.mjs for the first code exchange; not passed to the MCP server. Never commit.

TESLA_FLEET_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Client secret (alias)
TESLA_FLEET_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional alias for TESLA_CLIENT_SECRET (auth helper only; not used by the MCP server). Used only when TESLA_CLIENT_SECRET is unset. Never commit.

TESLA_FLEET_REGION.title: Region
TESLA_FLEET_REGION.description: Optional. na, eu or cn. Default: auto-detect via /api/1/users/region, then remembered in the token store.

TESLA_COMMAND_PROXY_URL.title: Command proxy URL
TESLA_COMMAND_PROXY_URL.description: Optional. YOUR tesla-http-proxy base URL, e.g. https://proxy.example.com:4443. Without it, command tools refuse and send nothing.

TESLA_FLEET_PROXY_URL.title: Command proxy URL (alias)
TESLA_FLEET_PROXY_URL.description: Optional alias for TESLA_COMMAND_PROXY_URL. Used only when TESLA_COMMAND_PROXY_URL is unset.

TESLA_COMMAND_PROXY_CA_CERT.title: Command proxy CA cert path
TESLA_COMMAND_PROXY_CA_CERT.description: Optional. Path to the PEM your proxy's TLS certificate chains to (or the self-signed cert). TLS verification is never disabled.

TESLA_TOKEN_STORE.title: Token store path
TESLA_TOKEN_STORE.description: Optional. Default: GROK_PLUGIN_DATA/tokens.json, else XDG state (Linux/macOS) or LOCALAPPDATA (Windows) under grokbot-vehicle-fleet/. File mode 0600; holds the rotated refresh token only.

TESLA_FLEET_READ_ONLY.title: Read-only mode
TESLA_FLEET_READ_ONLY.description: Optional. FAILS CLOSED: command tools are exposed ONLY when set to 0, false, no or off. Unset, empty, 1/true/yes/on, or any other value = read-only (commands hidden and refused).

TESLA_FLEET_ENABLE_LOCATION.title: Enable location
TESLA_FLEET_ENABLE_LOCATION.description: Optional opt-in. 1/true/yes/on lists get_location (coarse by default). Anything else = no location tool.

TESLA_DEFAULT_VIN.title: Default VIN
TESLA_DEFAULT_VIN.description: Optional default VIN for reads (placeholder 5YJ000000EXAMPLE). Unlock and trunk always need an explicit vin.

TESLA_DEFAULT_ENERGY_SITE_ID.title: Default energy site id
TESLA_DEFAULT_ENERGY_SITE_ID.description: Optional default energy_site_id for energy reads (placeholder 1234567890). Without it, the only energy site on the account is used.

TESLA_FLEET_KEY_DOMAIN.title: Virtual key domain
TESLA_FLEET_KEY_DOMAIN.description: Optional. Domain hosting your app's public key; used only to show the pairing link https://www.tesla.com/_ak/<domain>.

TESLA_FLEET_RATE_DATA_PER_USD.title: Rate: data calls per USD
TESLA_FLEET_RATE_DATA_PER_USD.description: Optional. Local usage estimate only (get_api_usage). Default 500 (Tesla published rate).

TESLA_FLEET_RATE_COMMANDS_PER_USD.title: Rate: commands per USD
TESLA_FLEET_RATE_COMMANDS_PER_USD.description: Optional. Local usage estimate only. Default 1000.

TESLA_FLEET_RATE_WAKES_PER_USD.title: Rate: wakes per USD
TESLA_FLEET_RATE_WAKES_PER_USD.description: Optional. Local usage estimate only. Default 50.

TESLA_FLEET_MONTHLY_DISCOUNT_USD.title: Monthly discount (USD)
TESLA_FLEET_MONTHLY_DISCOUNT_USD.description: Optional. Local usage estimate only. Default 10 (Tesla's monthly discount); 0 allowed.
